title: The Critical Value for the Beurling-Type Theorem in Weighted Bergman Spaces
summary: For every $α>1$ we construct a finite set $A\subset\mathbb{D}$ such that the zero-based invariant subspace $I_A$ fails the wandering subspace property. Consequently, the Beurling-type theorem holds on the weighted Bergman space $A^2_α$ if and only if $-1 1$, thereby replacing the constant $α_0\approx1.04$ in their result by $1$.
